findings.scope: Inherited product documentation; required before claiming complete REQ-005.6 documentation coverage
findings.issue: The product guide documents UTF-8, truncation, error propagation and color modes, but does not state how to view the positioned ANSI snapshot or what viewer capabilities it needs. The new test README is developer documentation and also does not supply product viewing instructions.
findings.impact: A user may open the export as plain text or replay it in a terminal smaller than the captured grid and not reproduce the intended image. This does not contradict the demonstrated file bytes or C003 behavior.
findings.minimalFix: Add a short product-guide paragraph describing UTF-8 plus CUP/SGR support, sufficient terminal dimensions, applicable color/glyph capability limits, and one suitable way to display the file; keep ordinary text-editor/plain-text viewing distinct.
findings.validation: Documentation inspection only; no product or build rerun required.
